_doc: What the copies build around the base while you are away, and while you watch. work = effort units. Each copy earns workPerHour (times its gather stat) per real hour counted from planet_states.data.npcTick, up to offlineCapHours, into the planet's shared work pool (data.village.work); liveWorkPerHour accrues while someone plays. A copy with enough pooled work picks a project by taste (its id hash weights the project weights) among those that still have a free slot on its own lot in the town (src/data/town.json slots: the house at the back, gardens, flag, totem, sign, the two lamp posts at the frontage, then street lamp spots nearby), walks there, hammers hammerSwings times and the build appears; builds are saved in data.structures with the builder (by), tint and variant. A copy whose lot is full builds nothing more. light = light the build casts (palette color). tint = painted in the builder's trail color. variants = pictogram frames (sign). solid = [w, h] blocking box. smoke = chimney puffs. sapling (weight 0): a young tree, planted only as a gift (planet_states.data.gifts).
